However, unlike when catching regular fish or other items, the random value used to determine whether a River Jelly is successfully caught is predetermined. This value only changes when catching a

. It is not changed by catching Algae, Trash, or any other catchable items. Because of this, after catching Trash using the Training Rod, it is necessary to catch a regular fish before another River Jelly. This can easily be done by switching to any
other than the Training Rod, continuing to fish until an actual fish is caught, and switching back to the Training Rod.
Ordinarily, 10% of possible random values result in a successful River Jelly catch. Each level of

increases the chance of a successful catch by 5%. So with +8 Luck, 50% of random values will result in a successful catch. This allows for longer streaks without failing a River Jelly catch, although the player will still unavoidably catch some Snake Skulls.
